title: Cauthon Info Hoster
description: This plugin hosts your server information as HTTP
body:
# Cauthon Info Hoster

1. Server Info Over HTTP: This plugin lets you see important stats about your server
2. Latest Chat Messages: It keeps track of the latest chat message on the server.
3. Discord Integration: Send messages from Discord to Minecraft and see them in Minecraft chat.

## Configuration

1. Find Config: Go to plugins/CauthonInfo/config.yml.
2. Set the Port: Set a port number in the config file, Default is 8080

## Usage

### Checking Server Stats
After setting the plugin up, you can view server stats by going to:

http://<your-server-ip>:<port>/tps

This page shows:

1. Current TPS: Ticks per second, the speed the server is running.
2. CPU Usage: How much of the CPU the server is using.
3. Memory (RAM) Usage: How much memory the server is using.
4. Storage Usage: How much disk space is in use.
5. Server Uptime: How long the server has been running since the last start.
6. Unique Player Joins: Number of unique players who have joined since the server started.

### View the Latest Chat Message

http://<your-server-ip>:<port>/chat

### Send Messages from Discord to Minecraft

If you have a bot or program set up to send HTTP POST requests to this plugin, use the following address:

http://<your-server-ip>:<port>/discord
